Abstract.By adding value to other emerging technologies, blockchain can im-
pact many business sectors and society.  Several areas are experiencing impro-
vements in their processes and greater data security, such as health, education
and finance. The objective of this work is to study the relationships and impacts
of blockchain on society, mainly due to applications in the most diverse areas.
For this,  a literature research was performed,  followed by the application of
an online questionnaire on aspects of blockchain in society, and a qualitative
analysis.  As preliminary results, health and finance were the areas that most
use blockchain, and the questionnaire revealed that it is important to study the
impacts of blockchain on society.
